moduleSummary: This module covers the earlier, upstream side of bringing new childcare providers into the DOE system: DOE staff issuing formal solicitations (RFPs/RFIs) to recruit vendors, tracking who responds, and then vetting and approving a new Family Child Care Network (FCCN) provider's application before it is affiliated with a network. This is distinct from the existing 'FCCN Network Provider Setup' guide, which only covers connecting an ALREADY-approved FCC Provider to a network — that guide picks up after the vetting and approval process described here has already finished.

scenarios.title: Setting up an internal staff member with Provider Procurement access
scenarios.description: Before a DOE internal administrator can approve provider applications or manage RFPs/RFIs, someone must give them the right permissions in their user settings (the 'Provider Management Team' and 'FCCN Internal Affiliation Management' access groups). Without this setup step, the relevant menu options and application links simply won't appear for them.
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.A Provider Procurement_Internal Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Setting up a vendor user with FCCN Provider Management access
scenarios.description: A DOE staff member finds a vendor organization's contact record, provisions them as a system user, and grants them the 'FCCN Provider Management' function so that person can log in and act on behalf of their organization (e.g., a network director submitting a new provider application) from that point forward.
scenarios.who: Internal Administrator (DOE staff) setting up a Vendor Administrator
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.V Provider Procurement_Vendor Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Issuing a new RFP/RFI to recruit vendors
scenarios.description: DOE staff record the basic details of a formal solicitation (a Request for Proposal or Request for Information) that is being put out to recruit new childcare provider organizations, so the effort is tracked in the system from the very beginning rather than only on paper or in email.
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: DOEECMS-1971
docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.A Provider Procurement_Internal Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Reviewing the list of open and past RFPs/RFIs
scenarios.description: DOE staff pull up the full list of solicitations that have been entered into the system, switch between different saved views, and open any individual solicitation to see its full details in one place.
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.A Provider Procurement_Internal Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Recording a vendor's response to an RFP/RFI
scenarios.description: When a vendor organization responds to a solicitation, DOE staff add them as a 'responder' on that RFP/RFI record, capturing who the point of contact is, which vendor they represent, and their proposed budget. If the vendor isn't already known to the system, staff can create a new lead record for them on the spot.
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.A Provider Procurement_Internal Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Correcting or updating a vendor's response details
scenarios.description: DOE staff go back into a previously-recorded vendor response and update information such as the point-of-contact name, vendor name, or proposed budget figure as the solicitation process moves forward and details are clarified.
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.A Provider Procurement_Internal Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Known issue: cannot add a contact person while responding to an RFP/RFI
scenarios.description: Testers found that staff were unable to add a point-of-contact ('lead') while recording a vendor's response to a solicitation, which would block the responder-tracking workflow described above.
scenarios.statusNote: Bug identified during Phase 1 regression testing; underlying feature not covered by any existing client-facing guide
sourceRefs: DOEECMS-2101

scenarios.title: Known issue: solicitation end date can be entered incorrectly without warning
scenarios.description: Testers found that the system did not properly validate the closing/end date entered for a solicitation, allowing dates that don't make sense (e.g., an end date before the start date) to be saved without any warning to staff.
scenarios.statusNote: Bug identified during Phase 1 regression testing; underlying feature not covered by any existing client-facing guide
sourceRefs: DOEECMS-2100

scenarios.title: Sending a new provider a link to apply for network affiliation
scenarios.description: A network's administrator (vendor side) starts the process of bringing on a new Family Child Care provider by generating and emailing that provider a personalized application link. Once the prospective provider fills out and submits the linked application, it is automatically routed to DOE staff for review.
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.V Provider Procurement_Vendor Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Checking on the status of a submitted provider application
scenarios.description: A network administrator opens their list of Family Child Care applications tied to their network and checks each one's current status (for example, whether it is still 'Submitted' and awaiting DOE review, or has moved further along in the vetting process).
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.V Provider Procurement_Vendor Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Completing a Preschool Screening Instrument (PSI) entry as part of vetting
scenarios.description: As part of vetting a prospective provider, the network administrator fills out a detailed screening form covering topics like curriculum planning, how children are engaged and supervised, indoor/outdoor safety, and general family child care information, then submits it for the provider's file.
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.V Provider Procurement_Vendor Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Known issue: PSI screening form can be submitted blank or misaligned
scenarios.description: Testers found two related problems with the PSI screening form used during provider vetting: the system allowed the form to be submitted completely empty with no required fields enforced, and some form fields displayed out of alignment when a user tried to proceed without checking a required box first.
scenarios.statusNote: Bug identified during Phase 1 regression testing; underlying feature not covered by any existing client-facing guide
sourceRefs: DOEECMS-2126
DOEECMS-2166

scenarios.title: Known issue: cannot attach supporting documents to a PSI interview
scenarios.description: Testers found that users were unable to upload supporting documents (such as photos or paperwork gathered during a site visit) to the PSI interview form, which would otherwise be part of documenting the vetting visit.
scenarios.statusNote: Bug identified during Phase 1 regression testing; underlying feature not covered by any existing client-facing guide
sourceRefs: DOEECMS-2122

scenarios.title: Reviewing and approving a submitted provider application
scenarios.description: DOE staff open a submitted Family Child Care provider application, review its details, and move it through the approval stages using an on-screen status tracker, finally marking it complete — at which point the provider officially becomes affiliated with the network.
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.A Provider Procurement_Internal Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Requesting more information or corrections from a vendor during review
scenarios.description: While reviewing an application, DOE staff can send it back to the vendor to ask for missing information or corrections, rather than approving or rejecting it outright, keeping the back-and-forth tracked within the same record.
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.A Provider Procurement_Internal Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Known issue: cannot submit the provider application form
scenarios.description: Testers found that the Family Child Care Network provider application form could not be submitted at all, which would block a prospective provider from starting the vetting process in the first place.
scenarios.statusNote: Bug identified during Phase 1 regression testing; underlying feature not covered by any existing client-facing guide
sourceRefs: DOEECMS-2167

scenarios.title: Known issue: application form shows duplicate fields and missing questions
scenarios.description: Testers found that the provider application form displayed duplicate fields, and separately that expected questions on the application sometimes failed to load at all, both of which would confuse an applicant filling out the form.
scenarios.statusNote: Bug identified during Phase 1 regression testing; underlying feature not covered by any existing client-facing guide
sourceRefs: DOEECMS-2118
DOEECMS-2098

scenarios.title: Known issue: internal staff lack access to Family Child Care Application links and quick-links panel
scenarios.description: Testers found that some internal FCCN-related staff accounts did not have access to the Family Child Care Application links they needed, and that shortcut ('quick link') buttons expected on the application record were missing entirely — both would prevent staff from reaching the application in the first place.
scenarios.statusNote: Bug identified during Phase 1 regression testing; underlying feature not covered by any existing client-facing guide
sourceRefs: DOEECMS-2115
DOEECMS-2121

scenarios.title: Known issue: error when sending an application invitation, and locked-out visibility rules
scenarios.description: Testers found that the flow for inviting a prospective provider to fill out an application could throw an unhandled system error, and separately flagged work to ensure FCCN users can only see records tied to their own active network affiliation (rather than being over- or under-restricted).
scenarios.statusNote: Bug identified during Phase 1 regression testing; underlying feature not covered by any existing client-facing guide
sourceRefs: DOEECMS-2097
DOEECMS-2144

scenarios.title: Viewing all networks affiliated with a vendor's account
scenarios.description: A network administrator looks at their own organization's account record to see the full list of DOE networks their organization is affiliated with, and can drill into any one of those affiliations for more detail.
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.V Provider Procurement_Vendor Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Adding a new contact person to a vendor's account
scenarios.description: DOE staff open a vendor organization's account and add a new contact person (such as a newly hired staff member at that organization) so that person's information is on file and available for future communication.
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.A Provider Procurement_Internal Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt

scenarios.title: Reviewing the full history of interactions with a vendor
scenarios.description: DOE staff open a vendor's account and check its activity history tab to see a running log of meetings, emails, and other interactions that have taken place with that organization over time.
scenarios.statusNote: Not covered by any existing guide
sourceRefs: docs/reference/Phase 1 UAT Visual Scripts/12.A Provider Procurement_Internal Adm_UAT Guide.pptx.txt
